name: Context Ledger
description: Automatic billion-context-style conversation compression. Maintains a per-session block ledger (summaries replace old ranges, originals kept restorable) and injects the compacted context view before every prompt build.

enabled.description: Master switch. false disables all hook activity (ledger keeps existing data). Can also be toggled at runtime with the CONTEXT_LEDGER_DISABLE env var.

dataDir.description: Directory for the per-session ledger JSON files. Defaults to <openclaw state>/context-ledger (or CONTEXT_LEDGER_DATA env).

compressThresholdTokens.description: Inject the compression reminder + compressible ranges once the estimated live context exceeds this many tokens.

viewTokens.description: Token budget for the injected compressed view (renderView limit). 0 = unbounded.

autoAppend.description: Append the live view (instead of only reminding) when the session is long. false = reminder-only, model calls compress itself.

apiBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL the plugin calls to write block summaries (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1). Falls back to CONTEXT_LEDGER_SUMMARIZER_BASE_URL env. Unset = deterministic extractive summaries.

apiKey.description: API key for the summarizer endpoint. Falls back to CONTEXT_LEDGER_SUMMARIZER_API_KEY env.

model.description: Model id used for summaries (e.g. gpt-4o-mini). Falls back to CONTEXT_LEDGER_SUMMARIZER_MODEL env.
